[EN] Rebel scum kiss their sisters.

Or they would if they had sisters.

At any rate, they're rebels, they're scum, and our princess is stronger than their princess.
[ES] La escoria rebelde besa a sus hermanas.

O lo harían si tuvieran hermanas.

En cualquier caso, son rebeldes, son escoria, y nuestra princesa es más fuerte que la de ellos.
